question.text: A bob of mass $M$ is suspended by a massless string of length $L$. The horizontal velocity $v$ at position $A$ is just sufficient to make it reach the point $B$. The angle $\theta$ at which the speed of the bob is half of that at $A$, satisfies

solution.text:
$v=\sqrt{5 g L}$
Solving Eqs. (i), (ii) and (iii) we get,
$$
\cos \theta=-\frac{7}{8} \quad \text { or } \theta=\cos ^{-1}\left(-\frac{7}{8}\right)=151^{\circ}
$$
$\therefore$ correct option is (d).
